key_insights: Monthly timeframes are providing the most reliable trading signals for both BTC and ETH
BTC is in a consolidation between 39k and mid-40s with 35-37k as key support below
ETH is struggling at the 3k level which has flipped from support to resistance
Crypto markets remain highly correlated with S&P 500 and Nasdaq - unlikely to decouple while equities decline
Best case scenario is equities bottom or inflation peaks, allowing crypto to potentially outperform on recovery
Failed breakdown patterns would be bullish for both BTC and ETH if they can reclaim key levels
summary: The episode analyzes Bitcoin and Ethereum during a period of high correlation with equities. BTC is consolidating in a range with 35-37k as key support. ETH is stuck below the 3k resistance level after breaking support. The speaker expects failed breakdown patterns to develop but notes that 30k breaking for BTC would be very bearish. Monthly timeframes are providing the clearest signals.
